subject: Post-call: Security evidence & approval path — next steps and owners
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Cole <erin.cole@mountainhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Aug 2024 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Security evidence & approval path — next steps and owners

Hi Erin — thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we all have the same playbook: 

1) Decision map we heard:
   - Economic buyer: Karen Holt (VP of IT Ops) — final pricing sign-off + contract
   - Security approver: Erin Cole (CISO) — needs SOC 2 summary, pen test highlights, data-flow diagram
   - Legal / Procurement: Mike Tan (Legal) + procurement@mountainhealth.com — standard T&Cs + DPA questions

2) Deliverables Redwood will provide this week (I propose):
   - SOC2_Summary_v1.pdf (summary + link to full report) — by EOD Thu
   - PenTest_Highlights_2023.pdf — by Friday; redacted vendor report and list of high/medium findings
   - Data_Retention_FAQ.md — short doc on retention, deletion, backup, and access logs
   - redwood-runtime-sla-2024.pdf — basic SLA we can include in proposal

3) Ask from Mountain Health:
   - Confirm whether procurement requires redlines up front or after SOW (inked vs. redlines)
   - Mike: any specific legal clauses that will block a pilot (IP, indemnity, data residency)?

4) Timeline suggestion: Pilot (1 month) -> Security sign-off -> Contract execution within 30–45 days.

Next step: I will attach the items above and loop Marcus (integration lead) and Priya (customer success) to handle pilot setup and audit log instrumentation. Marcus / Priya — can you confirm availability for a 30-min kickoff next week?

Attaching: [Attachment: SOC2_Summary_v1.pdf (pdf), PenTest_Highlights_2023.pdf (pdf), Data_Retention_FAQ.md (text), redwood-runtime-sla-2024.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks —
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Erin Cole <erin.cole@mountainhealth.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike Tan <mike.tan@mountainhealth.com>, procurement@mountainhealth.com
Date: Thu, 22 Aug 2024 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security evidence & approval path — next steps and owners

Diego — thanks for the thorough recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Timeline: security will need at least 5 business days to review the SOC2 summary and pen test highlights. If there are follow-up questions we may request a short walkthrough with your security/engineering team.
- Procurement: we generally expect a first pass at redlines before legal signs off on pilot contracts. Mike, is that still accurate?
- Data residency: we have a requirement that PHI-derived logs cannot leave the us-east-1 region. Can you confirm how Redwood handles audit log storage and whether we can pin that to our region?

Also: please include a short diagram (PNG/PDF) of the data flow for inference requests that shows what is logged, how long logs are retained by default, and any options for customer-managed keying. That will speed our review.

Cc'ing Mike and procurement to pick up contract questions.

—Erin
Erin Cole
CISO, Mountain Health

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Cole <erin.cole@mountainhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Mike Tan <mike.tan@mountainhealth.com>, procurement@mountainhealth.com
Date: Thu, 22 Aug 2024 13:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security evidence & approval path — next steps and owners

Erin — good questions. Quick answers and what we attached: 

- Region / audit logs: By default audit logs are stored in the same region as the tenancy; we can pin logs to us-east-1 for your pilot and can support customer-managed KMS for encryption in transit and at rest. See Data_Retention_FAQ.md (attached) for retention defaults and options.
- Diagram: Attached data_flow_inference.png (inline in the PDF summary) — shows which pieces are redacted for shared models and what we store in the KV cache.
- Timeline: noted — we'll flag security review as high priority and stand by for follow-ups.
- Procurement / redlines: we can accept a redline pass prior to pilot. We also have a standard pilot agreement that allows limited evaluation with minimal commercial terms; happy to table that as needed.

Marcus / Priya — can you run the pilot availability check? We should propose two kickoff windows next week (Mon/Tue mornings).

Attachments referenced: [SOC2_Summary_v1.pdf, PenTest_Highlights_2023.pdf, Data_Retention_FAQ.md, redwood-runtime-sla-2024.pdf]

Diego

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Erin Cole <erin.cole@mountainhealth.com>, Mike Tan <mike.tan@mountainhealth.com>, procurement@mountainhealth.com
Date: Thu, 22 Aug 2024 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security evidence & approval path — next steps and owners

Thanks Diego — quick internal coordination note. 

- Pilot kickoff: I have availability Mon 8/26 10:00–11:30 PT and Tue 8/27 09:00–11:00 PT. Priya, do those work on your side for CS/onsite instrumentation?
- Integration checklist (short):
   * API keys & ephemeral creds
   * Region pinning for audit logs (us-east-1)
   * Minimal sample dataset (PII redacted) for latency/cost profiling
   * Access for Mountain Health security to read-only audit logs for 7 days

I will prepare a one-page integration runbook (internal) and share the link by EOD.

Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Mike Tan <mike.tan@mountainhealth.com>
To: procurement@mountainhealth.com, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>, Erin Cole <erin.cole@mountainhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Aug 2024 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Security evidence & approval path — next steps and owners

Diego / Team — procurement here. Two quick asks from legal to keep the pilot moving: 

1) Please send the standard SOW + pilot terms with the indemnity and data processing clauses highlighted so we can ingest it into our contract review system.
2) We need confirmation on data deletion process at pilot end (who performs deletion and whether you provide a deletion certificate).

If you can provide those two items by EOD Monday, we should be able to start the redline pass early next week.

Thanks —
Mike Tan
Counsel, Mountain Health Procurement
